headline: Chest-high good-angle swell with an offshore dawn — RI's best today.
today: Sets to 2.6ft from the SSE on a good angle, dawn offshore N going cross-off into the morning. That's your window before the S onshore mushes it out midday. Shortboard or fish will work early. Best RI has all week, though the short period keeps it from being a must-drive.

daysToWatch.note: Prime SE angle with real period, glassy light dawn — but only knee-high. Pretty, not powerful.
Size returns to 3ft-plus but it's short-period S under 12-14mph cross wind. Bigger on the chart than in the water.
